title: Ear-EEG motor execution dataset from Wu et al 2020
description: This dataset contains simultaneous scalp and ear-EEG recordings from six healthy right-handed participants performing cued left- and right-hand fist clenching (motor execution). It comprises 1114 trials recorded at 1000 Hz with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier. The data support evaluation of in-ear sensing for motor task classification and brain-computer interface research. This BIDS version was generated with MOABB from the original Zenodo deposit.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 system at 1000 Hz using Ag/AgCl sensors (122 EEG channels plus 10 misc channels, standard_1005 montage, 0.5-100 Hz online bandpass). Participants performed visually cued left- or right-hand fist clenching over 4 s trials, with simultaneous scalp and ear-EEG recording.
